variants.label: RE-USE NemotronLabs (separate env) [analysis only]
variants.note: ANALYSIS ONLY: do not export this output as training audio before a listening test and the verification gates (speaker identity, ASR WER vs baseline, no crowd-voice claim). NVIDIA RE-USE, OpenMDW 1.1. Trained on synthetic single-speaker speech (en/de/es/fr/zh), no Vietnamese; it keeps the main speaker and suppresses others where voices overlap, so check overlap regions; the model card does not discuss hallucination.

variants.note: ANALYSIS ONLY: do not export this output as training audio before a listening test and the verification gates (speaker identity, ASR WER vs baseline, no crowd-voice claim). Companion RE-USE checkpoint meant to preserve laughter better; same caveats as re_use. Laughter preservation is the vendor's claim, unverified here.

variants.label: RE-USE, blend 25
variants.note: RE-USE with 25% of the chain input mixed back. Blend: mixes the chain's unfiltered input back at the given percent (Iwamoto 2022, arXiv 2201.06685). RE-USE has no strength or threshold setting of its own (vendor scripts expose only chunk size, hop and bandwidth extension), so a lighter touch is made by mixing the input back. Nothing here is validated on Vietnamese.
